title: TF-IEP002: which trace solves the scenario?

questions.ask: Does a resource end up with the wrong value?
Does the plan destroy or replace something nobody meant to touch?
Is it about where a secret ends up: screen, state, plan file, log or Git?

otherwise: Trace 4: follow the run, where and how it executes
before: Tie-breakers when two options both work
caption: Read the scenario against the questions from the top: the first yes names the trace to walk.
alt: Decision ladder: a wrong value means follow the value; an unexpected destroy means follow the address; a secret means follow the secret; otherwise follow the run.
